$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFNU (AIP France, chart dated 2024-08-08): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Uzès

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
AD reserved for home based ACFT and ACFT based on the neighbouring AD (1).
For the external users, PPR to AD operator, PN at least 72 hours at the following address: aeroclub.uzes@gmail.com Simultaneous use of aircraft RWY and HEL RWY prohibited.
Usable declared distances: TODA RWY 17 reduced due to trees within the departure funnel.
QFU 354°, in AD pattern, mandatory to avoid flying over La Bruguière.
If this is not possible, crosswind behind this village.
Non home-based ACFT limited to 2 patterns.
HEL circuit identical to RWY circuit.
Hovering forbidden on th RWY for all helicopters.
Autorotation forbidden on the RWY for ACFT equipped with skids.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Trees pierce the lateral clearance areas to the East and West, see map ATT 01.
Do not use AD after heavy rain or during bad weather periods.
Electrical fence around RWY perimeter.
HEL area (300 x 30 m) located North West from AD reserved for State, Civil Security, and Emergency Services helicopters.
AEM (NR 9549): 500 ft ASFC, HJ (1) Aérodromes voisins / Neighbouring AD:
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
AD réservé aux ACFT basés et à ceux basés sur les AD voisins (1).

Pour les usagers extérieurs, sur autorisation préalable de l'exploitant AD, demande à déposer au moins 72 heures à l'avance à l'adresse suivante : aeroclub.uzes@gmail.com Utilisation simultanée piste avions et piste HEL interdite.
Distances déclarées utilisables : TODA RWY 17 réduite cause arbres dans la trouée de décollage.
En cas d'impossibilité, passer en vent traversier derrière ce village.
Aéronefs non basés limités à 2 tours de piste.
Circuit HEL identique au circuit avion.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY. Parking visiteurs entre la manche à air et le club-house.
Des arbres percent les surfaces latérales de dégagement à l'Est et à l'Ouest, voir carte ATT 01.
Clôture électrique en périphérie de la piste.
Zone hélicoptère (300 x 30 m) au nord-ouest du terrain réservée aux hélicoptères de l'État, de la Sécurité Civile et des Services d'Urgence.
